urban.palette: Night exteriors, sodium streetlight, brick, amber vs ice-blue contrast.
urban.motifs: Strut, cypher, rooftop, low-angle hero presence.
urban.camera: Handheld tracking, crash zooms on accents, motivated practicals.
urban.writer: Boast, confession, or come-up in images; no fake brand merch.

electronic.palette: Deep navy/black, neon practicals, volumetric shafts, single warm accent.
electronic.motifs: Suspension, freefall on drops, hollow interior space, frozen time.
electronic.camera: Crane descents, orbits, whip-zooms on hits.
electronic.writer: Singular protagonist, emotional gravity over plot dump.

pop.palette: Clean high-key or glossy night; one signature wardrobe color.
pop.motifs: Hooks as visual refrains; mirror/phone/stage motifs sparingly.
pop.camera: Steadicam verses, wider chorus geography, crisp cuts on downbeats.
pop.writer: Clear emotional want; keep generative-video-friendly faces/bodies.

rock.palette: Stage tungsten, smoke, daylight grit, denim/leather textures.
rock.motifs: Live energy, road, rehearsal rooms, crowd surge on chorus.
rock.camera: Handheld pit energy, slow push on bridges.
rock.writer: Conflict and release; avoid copyrighted lyric quotes.

acoustic.palette: Warm daylight, wood, linen, soft window light.
acoustic.motifs: Hands, instruments, intimate rooms, landscape breathers.
acoustic.camera: Locked-off intimacy, gentle dollies, natural light priority.

global.palette: Saturated local color, golden hour, market/street practicals.
global.motifs: Community, dance circles, procession, city-to-landscape contrast.
global.camera: Wide establishing + close rhythm cuts on percussion.
global.writer: Culture-specific motifs without costume cliché; respect locality.

metal.palette: High contrast B/W or desaturated cold steel; strobe accents.
metal.camera: Aggressive push-ins, whip pans on blasts.
metal.writer: Power and catharsis; keep practical, not cartoon CGI.

dance.palette: Club RGB, lasers, wet floors, dawn-after exteriors.
dance.motifs: Bodies in sync, DJ booth glimpses, euphoria vs comedown.
dance.camera: Sweeping cranes, rhythmic jump cuts on kicks.
dance.writer: Physical joy and release; faceless-enough for generative video.

jazz-soul.palette: Warm tungsten, brass highlights, velvet shadow.
jazz-soul.motifs: Club booths, late-night streets, intimate duets.
jazz-soul.camera: Slow orbits, smoke shafts, soft rack focus.

experimental.palette: Unnatural grades, film damage, sparse practicals.
experimental.motifs: Abstract body, glitch, surreal object logic.
experimental.camera: Jump cuts, locked surreal frames, unexpected angles.
experimental.writer: Image-led meaning; avoid explaining the metaphor.
